set(PROJ_SRC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR})

# Include the launcher icon generated by LVGL's official image converter.
# CONFIGURE_DEPENDS is intentionally omitted for ESP-IDF script-mode support.
file(GLOB_RECURSE PROJ_SRCS_C ${PROJ_SRC}/*.c)

idf_component_register(
    SRCS ${PROJ_SRCS_C} "ButtonTest.cpp"
    INCLUDE_DIRS ${PROJ_SRC}
    REQUIRES brookesia_core esp32_s3_touch_amoled_1_75 esp_driver_gpio
    WHOLE_ARCHIVE
)

set_source_files_properties(
    "ButtonTest.cpp"
    PROPERTIES COMPILE_FLAGS "-Wno-missing-field-initializers"
)
